candidates.description: This feature vector represents Spanish abstract noun suffixes and words ending in feminine nominal suffixes denoting qualities or states.
This feature represents automated systems, artificial intelligence, and malicious software agents.
This vector represents Spanish adjectives and demonstratives commonly used to modify nouns in descriptions or comparisons.
This vector represents Spanish nouns and lexical roots related to systems, processes, and abstract concepts.
This vector activates for common Spanish derivational suffixes and morphological endings used in verb conjugation and noun formation.
This feature vector represents modifiers and qualifiers that describe the nature, type, or origin of various nouns and concepts.
This feature vector represents inflections of common Spanish action and linking verbs, particularly in the present and past tenses.
This vector represents the concept of utilization, usage, and the act of employing tools or features.
Common Spanish infinitive action verbs denoting general everyday activities and states.
This feature vector represents categorical terms and classifications related to types, functions, and elements.
